features.name: Content pipeline parity

features.name: Committed build output freshness

features.name: Local asset references resolve
features.description: Every local url()/href/src in docs/build.css and docs/index.html must resolve to a file under docs/ (fonts, certificates, work samples).

features.name: Design system overhaul
features.description: Web-first redesign on branch redesign/resume-site. oklch zinc tokens with a dark/light theme, Inter + Geist Mono, 768px column, full-bleed screen lines, diagonal-stripe dividers, hairline panels with counted titles, icon-tile rows, rounded-full mono tags, numbered stack rows, profile header with the name and rotating taglines. Removed on request: the decorative mark block, handwritten greeting and note, Fig. caption, local clock, Highlights panel, avatar roundel and footer info rows. Replaces the two-page A4 print layout.
features.evidence: ./init.sh passes; browser check on http://localhost:8099: 8 panels, 9 stripe dividers, 86 tags, column [336,768], header 56px sticky, no overflow; no rounded-[inherit] avatar, footer dl count 0 with 3 social links; theme toggle light<->dark persisted; flip sentences, scroll-spy aria-current and 9 copy buttons respond; Inter + GeistMono
